text:
The PMOS mirror bug is the likely cause: `n.M` W looks like a per-finger width, so `W=Wu*nf, m=nf` builds nf² units. Fixing it to `W=Wu, m=nf` should put the folded stage back in bias.

```json
{"action": "edit", "reason": "n.M W is per finger: M3/M4/M7 got nf^2 units (M7 217uA, M3 23uA vs 7uA), crushing fold nodes and output. Set W=Wu with m=nf so each finger matches the unit reference exactly; bias, gain, swing, power restore."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "g1":   (19.0, 14.0, 23.0),     # diff pair gm/Id
    "L1":   (2.0, 0.8, 4.0),        # diff pair L
    "It":   (7e-6, 5e-6, 9e-6),     # tail current (rounded to unit multiples)
    "g6":   (16.0, 10.0, 19.0),     # 2nd-stage NMOS gm/Id
    "L6":   (0.5, 0.3, 1.0),
    "fgbw": (9.0e6, 7.8e6, 12e6),   # target GBW -> sets Cc
    "kp2":  (2.7, 1.8, 3.4),        # p2 / GBW ratio -> sets gm6
    "rzk":  (2.5, 1.0, 4.0),        # Rz = rzk/gm6
    "gp":   (8.0, 6.0, 11.0),       # PMOS current-source gm/Id
    "Lp":   (1.5, 0.8, 3.0),
    "gm":   (8.0, 5.0, 12.0),       # bottom NMOS mirror gm/Id
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vdd = 1.8
    cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-12); iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6); vcm = spec.get("vcm", 0.9)
    Iu = 1.0e-6                       # PMOS unit-finger current (Mp0 reference)
    nf = max(2, int(round(p["It"] / Iu)))
    It = nf * Iu; Ib = It / 2.0       # each fold source carries It/2 + Ib = It
    Ip0 = Iu; Icp = 1.0e-6; Icn = Iu
    gnb, Lnb = 18.0, 4.0
    gc, Lc = 12.0, 0.5
    Lp = p["Lp"]

    vt = 0.25
    for _ in range(3):
        m1 = lut.size("n", p["g1"], p["L1"], It / 2, vds=1.5 - vt, vsb=vt)
        vt = vcm - m1.vgs
    mn0 = lut.size("n", gnb, Lnb, iref, vds=0.6)
    mt = lut.size("n", gnb, Lnb, It, vds=max(vt, 0.15))
    mnb1 = lut.size("n", gnb, Lnb, Ip0, vds=0.6)
    mnb2 = lut.size("n", gnb, Lnb, Icp, vds=0.6)
    # PMOS unit finger; all PMOS mirrors are integer multiples (m) of it
    mp0 = lut.size("p", p["gp"], Lp, Ip0, vds=0.9)
    Wu = mp0.W
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gp"], Lp, It, vds=0.4)        # model-only OP
    vsd_top = m3.vdsat + 0.17
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gp"], Lp, It, vds=vsd_top)
    mc = lut.size("p", gc, Lc, Ib, vds=0.6)
    mpc = lut.size("p", gc, Lc, Icp, vds=mc.vgs)
    Rp = vsd_top / Icp
    m9 = lut.size("n", p["gm"], 2.0, Ib, vds=0.3)
    vbm = m9.vdsat + 0.15
    m9 = lut.size("n", p["gm"], 2.0, Ib, vds=vbm)
    mcn = lut.size("n", gc, Lc, Ib, vds=0.4, vsb=vbm)
    mnc = lut.size("n", gc, Lc, Icn, vds=mcn.vgs, vsb=vbm)
    Rn = vbm / Icn

    gm1 = m1.gm
    Cc = gm1 / (2 * PI * p["fgbw"])
    clt = cl + 50e-15
    gm6t = p["kp2"] * 2 * PI * p["fgbw"] * clt
    n6 = max(2, int(round(gm6t / p["g6"] / Iu)))
    I6 = n6 * Iu
    mo = lut.size("n", p["g6"], p["L6"], I6, vds=0.9)
    m7 = lut.size("p", p["gp"], Lp, I6, vds=0.9)       # model-only OP
    clt = cl + mo.cdd + m7.cdd
    gm6 = mo.gm
    Rz = p["rzk"] / gm6

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("Mn0", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mn0)
    n.dev("Mtail", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mt)
    n.dev("Mnb1", "vbp", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mnb1)
    n.M("Mp0", "vbp", "vbp", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wu, Lp, m=1)
    n.dev("Mnb2", "vcp", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mnb2)
    n.R("Rp", "vdd", "sp", Rp)
    n.dev("Mpc", "vcp", "vcp", "sp", "sp", mpc)
    n.M("Mpb", "vcn", "vbp", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wu, Lp, m=1)
    n.dev("Mnc", "vcn", "vcn", "sn", "vss", mnc)
    n.R("Rn", "sn", "vss", Rn)
    n.dev("M1", "fa", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "fb", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.M("M3", "fa", "vbp", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wu, Lp, m=nf)
    n.M("M4", "fb", "vbp", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wu, Lp, m=nf)
    n.dev("Mca", "v1", "vcp", "fa", "fa", mc)
    n.dev("Mcb", "vx", "vcp", "fb", "fb", mc)
    n.dev("Mncb", "vx", "vcn", "nbx", "vss", mcn)
    n.dev("M9", "nbx", "vx", "vss", "vss", m9)
    n.dev("Mnca", "v1", "vcn", "nb1", "vss", mcn)
    n.dev("M10", "nb1", "vx", "vss", "vss", m9)
    n.dev("Mo", "vout", "v1", "vss", "vss", mo)
    n.M("M7", "vout", "vbp", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wu, Lp, m=n6)
    n.R("Rz", "v1", "nz", Rz)
    n.C("Cc", "nz", "vout", Cc)

    ro_fold = 1.0 / (m1.gds + m3.gds)
    Rup = mc.gm * (1 / mc.gds) * ro_fold
    Rdn = mcn.gm * (1 / mcn.gds) * (1 / m9.gds)
    R1 = 1.0 / (1 / Rup + 1 / Rdn)
    A1 = gm1 * R1
    A2 = gm6 / (mo.gds + m7.gds)
    A0 = A1 * A2
    ugbw = 0.9 * gm1 / (2 * PI * Cc)
    wu = 2 * PI * ugbw
    p2 = gm6 / clt
    zden = Rz - 1 / gm6
    C1 = mo.cgg + 2 * mc.cdd
    p3 = 1 / (Rz * C1 + 1e-30)
    Cfa = m3.cdd + m1.cdd + mc.cgg
    pfold = mc.gm / (Cfa + 1e-30)
    pmir = m9.gm / (2 * m9.cgg + 1e-30)
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(wu / p2)) - math.degrees(math.atan(wu / p3)) \
         - math.degrees(math.atan(wu / pfold)) - 0.5 * math.degrees(math.atan(wu / pmir))
    if zden > 0:
        pm += math.degrees(math.atan(wu * Cc * zden))
    pm -= 8.0
    psrr = A1 * gm6 / m7.gds / 10.0
    cmrr = A0 * 2 * gm1 / (mt.gds * 300)
    sr = min(It / Cc, 2 * Ib / Cc, I6 / (cl + Cc))
    t_settle = 0.5 / sr + 4.6 / (wu * 0.7)
    kT = 1.38e-23 * 300
    th = 8 * kT * (2 / 3) / gm1 * (1 + m3.gm / gm1 + m9.gm / gm1)
    fl = (3.5e-7) ** 2 * (2.0 * 10.0) / max(m1.W * m1.L, 1.0)
    noise = math.sqrt(th + fl)
    itot = iref + Ip0 + Icp + Icn + 2 * It + I6
    swing = vdd - mo.vdsat - m7.vdsat - 0.1
    return n, {"gain_db": db(A0), "ugbw": ugbw, "pm": pm, "power": vdd * itot,
               "psrr_db": db(psrr), "cmrr_db": db(cmrr), "slew": sr, "settle": t_settle,
               "swing": swing, "noise_1k": noise}
```
